title: Adversarial Contrast Pairs for Oversight Training: Teaching Overseers to Detect Subtle Errors

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Mapping overseer blind spots is a prerequisite for fixing them. If overseers have structured blind spots, models trained on their supervision inherit biases. Direct chain from measurement to oversight improvement.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Generating contrast pairs can be done via LLM API calls. Testing overseer accuracy on these pairs is straightforward. The main challenge is designing good contrast pairs that are subtly wrong. Accessible with mentor guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Generate contrast pairs, test overseer on them, report error profile. Single clear deliverable: a blind spot map. Focused and achievable in 30 hours if limited to one task domain.
